title: I realized I never posted a vlog from the Hadestown pro shot premiere...
transcript: come with me to the world premiere of the Hadestown musical Pro shot at Tribeca Film Festival Hadestown is my favourite musical and the second it was announced that they were shooting a pro shot I knew I was going to the premiere I didn't care where it was but luckily it was at Tribeca meaning that it was in my city and I could buy a ticket so it was not that hard but I was feeling emotional about it because over a year earlier my friends and I had gone to London to see the OBC he's we were there for the very first show and it was so special but obviously we hadn't gotten to see Patrick Page because he had just gotten injured and I was so devastated about it even though I love Philip Buchanan but I just couldn't wait to see Patrick Page as Hades again and see how they accommodated his injury anyway because it was the premiere the original Broadway principals were there they were all in the carpet it was really and to see and then we headed into the theater for the film now I am biased I have seen Hadestown many many times again I love the musical I was fully prepared to love it no matter what but genuinely this is the best live capture I've ever seen of a show every single shot feels intentional every camera movement has purpose every close up arrives at the exact right emotional moment it never sacrificed the feeling of live theater but it also fully embrace what film could do you get these incredibly gorgeous wide shots to experience the set and the turntables and the choreography the architecture that makes Hadestown feel like Hadestown then you get the close UPS that capture all of the intimate moments that even from the best seat in the house you can't see and the performances we got from these actors are insane my girl Amber Gray especially her Persephone is wild and funny and heartbreaking and gruff and like has anyone ever won an Oscar for a pro shot cause I think we should try and seeing her with Patrick Page again just gave me chills he is astonishing in this if anything the Cain and the boot add to his character it works truly so well you would never know unless you know Eva and Reeve remain the emotional heartbeat every glance between them every moment of connection the single teardrop that rolled down Orpheus's face I cannot and our ethereal magical Andrea Shields he is a mythic and will be forever and I'm so glad we have this capture I also deeply love that the London cast gets to be integrated into this all those different voices all the different accents it gives this production such a unique texture that feels so Hadestown just timeless and universal the way it should be the film never tries to hide that you're watching theater the audience and their reactions are integrated so well it celebrates what makes live performance magical and the cinema only deepens the experience I am so grateful that this pro shot exists productions and casts like this deserve to be preserved forever and now audiences all over the world can discover Hadestown it's an old song but I'm so glad that we keep getting to sing it again and again and again if you have a chance go see the Hadestown Pro shot in theaters they just extended and if you're not in North America I promise it's coming soon and it is worth the wait
